title: Prime Minister's Employment Generation Programme
description: A credit-linked subsidy program aimed at generating self-employment opportunities through the establishment of micro-enterprises in the non-farm sector. It provides financial assistance in the form of margin money subsidy for setting up new projects.
eligibility_text: Any individual, above 18 years of age. Minimum 8th standard pass is required for projects costing above ₹10 lakh in the manufacturing sector and above ₹5 lakh in the service sector. Only new projects are considered. Self Help Groups (SHGs), institutions registered under Societies Registration Act, 1860, charitable trusts, etc., are also eligible. Existing units or units already availed government subsidy under any other scheme are not eligible.
benefits_text: Margin Money (subsidy) for General category is 25% (urban) and 35% (rural) of the project cost. For Special categories (SC/ST/OBC/Minorities/Women/Ex-servicemen/Physically Handicapped/NER), it is 25% (urban) and 35% (rural). The maximum project cost is ₹50 lakh for manufacturing units and ₹20 lakh for service units.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
application_steps: Step 1: Submit online application through the PMEGP e-Portal.
Step 2: Undergo a mandatory Entrepreneurship Development Program (EDP) training.
Step 3: Apply for a loan to a bank listed in the scheme. Bank appraises project and sanctions loan.
Step 4: KVIC/KVIB/DIC releases margin money subsidy to the bank after the bank's loan sanction and initial disbursement.

title: Stand-Up India Scheme
description: Facilitates bank loans between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore to at least one Scheduled Caste (SC) or Scheduled Tribe (ST) borrower and at least one woman borrower per bank branch for setting up a greenfield enterprise. It promotes entrepreneurship among underserved segments of society.
eligibility_text: SC/ST and/or women entrepreneurs, above 18 years of age. Loans are only for greenfield projects (first-time venture) in manufacturing, services, or trading sector. Borrower should not be a defaulter to any bank/financial institution. In case of non-individual enterprises, 51% of shareholding and controlling stake should be held by either SC/ST and/or Woman entrepreneur.
benefits_text: Composite loan (Term Loan + Working Capital) between ₹10 lakh and ₹1 crore, covering 75% of the project cost including term loan and working capital. The interest rate would be the lowest applicable rate of the bank for that category (not to exceed Base Rate (MCLR) + 3% + Tenor Premium).
ministry: Ministry of Finance
application_steps: Step 1: Register on Stand-Up Mitra portal and prepare a detailed project report.
Step 2: Approach a bank branch directly or through the Stand-Up Mitra portal for loan application.
Step 3: Bank assesses the application, project viability, and creditworthiness.
Step 4: Loan sanction and disbursement upon meeting all criteria and documentation requirements.

title: Startup India Seed Fund Scheme
description: Aims to provide financial assistance to startups for proof of concept, prototype development, product trials, market-entry, and commercialization. It supports innovative startups across various sectors by bridging the funding gap at early stages.
eligibility_text: A startup recognized by DPIIT, incorporated not more than 2 years ago at the time of application. It must have an innovative product or service with a strong business plan, and not have received more than ₹10 lakh of monetary support from any other Central or State Government scheme (except prizes won at competitions). Startups applying should not have prior equity funding of more than ₹10 crore.
benefits_text: Seed Fund up to ₹20 lakh for validation of Proof of Concept, prototype development, or product trials (through grants). Seed Fund up to ₹50 lakh for market entry, commercialization, or scaling up through convertible debentures or debt-linked instruments.
ministry: Ministry of Commerce and Industry (Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade - DPIIT)

Step 2: Prepare a detailed application, including business plan, pitch deck, and financial projections.
Step 3: Apply through the Startup India portal by selecting an eligible incubator.
Step 4: Applications are evaluated by an Experts Advisory Committee (EAC) appointed by the incubator for recommendation.

title: Credit Guarantee Fund Trust for Micro and Small Enterprises
title_hi: सूक्ष्म और लघु उद्यमों के लिए क्रेडिट गारंटी फंड ट्रस्ट
title_kn: ಸೂಕ್ಷ್ಮ ಮತ್ತು ಸಣ್ಣ ಉದ್ದಿಮೆಗಳಿಗಾಗಿ ಕ್ರೆಡಿಟ್ ಗ್ಯಾರಂಟಿ ಫಂಡ್ ಟ್ರಸ್ಟ್
description: Provides collateral-free credit to micro and small enterprises (MSEs). The Trust guarantees a portion of the credit facility extended by eligible lending institutions to MSEs, thereby encouraging banks to lend to this sector without requiring collateral.
eligibility_text: New and existing Micro and Small Enterprises (MSEs), including those in the manufacturing and service sectors, which are eligible for credit facilities (term loans and/or working capital) from scheduled commercial banks, select Regional Rural Banks (RRBs), and other eligible lending institutions. The credit facility should be up to ₹5 crore.
benefits_text: Credit guarantee coverage for collateral-free loans up to ₹5 crore per eligible MSE unit. The guarantee covers up to 85% for micro enterprises (up to ₹5 lakh), 75% for credit up to ₹5 crore, and 80% for women/MSEs in NER/SC/ST categories.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
application_steps: Step 1: Prepare your business plan and required documents for a credit facility.
Step 2: Approach an eligible Member Lending Institution (MLI) (bank/NBFC) for a loan.
Step 3: The MLI assesses your loan application and, if eligible, applies for CGTMSE guarantee cover on your behalf.
Step 4: Once the guarantee cover is approved, the MLI disburses the loan without requiring collateral.

title: PM Vishwakarma Yojana
description: Aims to provide holistic support to traditional artisans and craftspeople (Vishwakarmas) through skill training, modern tools, credit support, marketing support, and digital payments incentives. It preserves traditional skills and integrates them into the modern value chain.
eligibility_text: Artisans and craftspeople aged 18 years and above, engaged in one of the 18 identified traditional trades (e.g., carpenter, boat maker, blacksmith, potter, sculptor, tailor, washerman). Beneficiary should not have availed loan under similar Central/State credit-based schemes for self-employment/business development in the past 5 years. One member from one family can apply.
benefits_text: Recognition as a Vishwakarma through a certificate and ID card. Skill Upgradation (basic and advanced training) with a stipend of ₹500/day. Toolkit incentive of ₹15,000. Collateral-free credit support (Term Loan) - First Tranche: up to ₹1 lakh for 18 months, Second Tranche: up to ₹2 lakh for 30 months, both at a concessional interest rate of 5% p.a. Marketing support and digital transaction incentives.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises (MSME)
application_steps: Step 1: Register on the PM Vishwakarma portal at a Common Service Centre (CSC) or Gram Panchayat office using Aadhaar-linked mobile number.
Step 2: Complete the application form and provide required documents.
Step 3: Undergo verification by Gram Panchayat/ULB and District Implementation Committee.
Step 4: If approved, receive Vishwakarma ID card, certificate, and enroll for skill training and credit support through the portal.

eligibility_text: Women entrepreneurs establishing new units or expanding/modernizing existing ones in the small-scale sector. The enterprise must be primarily owned and managed by women. The loan can be availed for a wide range of industrial and service activities.
benefits_text: Soft loan assistance for projects, typically covering up to 85-90% of the project cost. SIDBI provides an equity-type assistance (soft loan) of 10-15% of the project cost. Repayment period can extend up to 10 years including a moratorium period.

eligibility_text: Any woman can open an account for herself. A guardian can open an account on behalf of a minor girl. There is no specific age limit for adult women to open this account. It is accessible to all women and girls.

title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi
description: Provides income support to all eligible landholding farmer families across the country to supplement their financial needs. The scheme aims to ensure proper crop health and appropriate yields, commensurate with the anticipated income from agricultural activity.
eligibility_text: All landholding farmer families, which have cultivable land in their names, are eligible. Exclusions include institutional landholders; former and present holders of constitutional posts; former and present Ministers/State Ministers; former/present MPs/MLAs/MLCs; former and present Mayors of Municipal Corporations, former and present Chairpersons of District Panchayats; all serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries/Offices/Departments and their field units, Central or State PSEs and Attached Offices/Autonomous Institutions under Government as well as regular employees of the Local Bodies (excluding Multi Tasking Staff /Class IV/Group D employees); all superannuated/retired pensioners whose monthly pension is ₹10,000/- or more (excluding Multi Tasking Staff /Class IV/Group D employees); and all persons who paid Income Tax in the last assessment year. Professionals like Doctors, Engineers, Lawyers, Chartered Accountants, and Architects registered with professional bodies and carrying out profession by undertaking practices are also excluded.
benefits_text: Financial benefit of ₹6,000 per year, payable in three equal instalments of ₹2,000 each, every four months, directly transferred to the bank accounts of the beneficiaries.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
application_steps: Step 1: Visit the PM-KISAN portal (pmkisan.gov.in) and click on 'New Farmer Registration'.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar number, captcha, and state. Click on 'Search'.
Step 3: Fill in personal details, land records, bank account details, and upload necessary documents.
Step 4: Submit the application for verification by state authorities.

title: Pradhan Mantri Fasal Bima Yojana
description: Provides comprehensive insurance cover against failure of crops, thereby helping in stabilising the income of farmers. It aims to provide financial support to farmers suffering crop loss/damage arising out of unforeseen events.
eligibility_text: All farmers including sharecroppers and tenant farmers growing the notified crops in the notified areas are eligible. Compulsory for farmers who have taken institutional loans (KCC/Crop Loan) for notified crops. Voluntary for other farmers.
benefits_text: Insurance cover for crop loss due to non-preventable natural risks (e.g., drought, flood, hailstorm, landslide), pests, and diseases. Farmers pay a nominal premium: 2% for all Kharif crops, 1.5% for all Rabi crops, and 5% for commercial/horticultural crops. The remaining premium is borne by the Central and State Governments.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
application_steps: Step 1: Farmers can apply online through the PMFBY portal or offline through banks, cooperative societies, or Common Service Centers (CSCs).
Step 2: Submit required documents including land records, bank passbook, Aadhaar card, and crop sowing declaration.
Step 3: Pay the applicable premium amount.
Step 4: Receive confirmation of insurance cover.

eligibility_text: All farmers — individual/joint cultivators, tenant farmers, oral lessees, and sharecroppers are eligible. Farmers must be engaged in agricultural operations or allied activities.
benefits_text: Short-term credit limit for crop production, post-harvest expenses, marketing loans, and working capital for allied activities. title: Pradhan Mantri Krishi Sinchayee Yojana

eligibility_text: All farmers are eligible. title: Soil Health Card Scheme
description: Aims to provide every farmer with a Soil Health Card (SHC) to assess the nutrient status of their soil and recommend appropriate doses of nutrients and soil amendments. This helps farmers to improve soil fertility and productivity sustainably.
eligibility_text: All farmers who own cultivable land are eligible to receive a Soil Health Card.
benefits_text: A personalized Soil Health Card every 2 years, which contains details about the nutrient status of their soil, along with recommendations on the appropriate dosage of nutrients (fertilizers) and necessary soil amendments for different crops. The card is provided free of cost to farmers.
ministry: Ministry of Agriculture & Farmers Welfare
application_steps: Step 1: State agriculture departments collect soil samples from farmers' fields across the country.
Step 2: Soil samples are tested in soil testing laboratories for various parameters (N, P, K, micro-nutrients, pH, EC, Organic Carbon).
Step 3: Based on the test results, recommendations are formulated for crop-wise nutrient management.
Step 4: Soil Health Cards are generated and distributed to farmers by the agriculture department, often through village-level camps.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban
description: This scheme aims to provide affordable housing to all eligible urban poor, including slum dwellers, by ensuring a pucca house with basic amenities. It is implemented through four verticals: In-situ Slum Redevelopment, Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS), Affordable Housing in Partnership, and Beneficiary-led Individual House Construction/Enhancement.
eligibility_text: A beneficiary family should not own a pucca house in their name or in the name of any family member (husband, wife, unmarried sons, and/or unmarried daughters) in any part of India. The household income criteria for different categories are: Economically Weaker Section (EWS) with annual household income up to ₹3 lakh; Low Income Group (LIG) with annual household income between ₹3 lakh and ₹6 lakh; Middle Income Group-I (MIG-I) with annual household income between ₹6 lakh and ₹12 lakh; and Middle Income Group-II (MIG-II) with annual household income between ₹12 lakh and ₹18 lakh.
benefits_text: Under the Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS), beneficiaries receive interest subsidy on home loans: EWS/LIG households receive 6.5% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹6 lakh, MIG-I households receive 4% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹9 lakh, and MIG-II households receive 3% interest subsidy on loans up to ₹12 lakh. Other components provide financial assistance or housing development.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
application_steps: Visit the official PMAY-U website (pmaymis.gov.in) or a Common Service Centre (CSC) / bank / empanelled agency.
Choose the appropriate component (e.g., CLSS, Beneficiary-led construction) based on eligibility.
Fill out the application form with personal, income, and property details.
Upload required documents and submit the application.

title: Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Gramin
description: This scheme aims to provide a pucca house with basic amenities to all houseless households and households living in kutcha and dilapidated houses in rural areas. It offers financial assistance for the construction of houses, along with additional support for sanitation and unskilled labour.
eligibility_text: Beneficiaries are identified based on the housing deprivation parameters of the Socio Economic Caste Census (SECC) 2011 data, subject to validation by Gram Sabhas. Houseless households and those living in 0, 1, or 2 kutcha room houses are prioritized. The beneficiary must not own a pucca house anywhere in India. Priority is given to vulnerable groups including SC/ST households, minorities, PwDs, and women-headed households.
benefits_text: Financial assistance of ₹1.20 lakh in plain areas and ₹1.30 lakh in hilly states/difficult areas/Integrated Action Plan (IAP) districts for house construction. Beneficiaries are also entitled to 90-95 days of unskilled labour wage under MGNREGA and ₹12,000 for the construction of toilets under Swachh Bharat Mission (Gramin) (SBM-G).
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
application_steps: Identification of beneficiaries is done from the SECC 2011 data, validated by Gram Sabha.
The finalized list of beneficiaries is published by the Gram Panchayat.
Eligible households approach the Gram Panchayat or Block Development Office to complete the application process.
Necessary documents are verified and uploaded to the PMAY-G online system.

title_kn: ದೀನದಯಾಳ್ ಅಂತ್ಯೋದಯ ಯೋಜನೆ - ರಾಷ್ಟ್ರೀಯ ನಗರ ಜೀವನೋಪಾಯ ಮಿಷನ್
description: This mission aims to reduce poverty and vulnerability of the urban poor households by enabling them to access gainful self-employment and skilled wage employment opportunities. It provides support through skill development, self-employment programs with subsidized loans, and better access to basic social services.
eligibility_text: Target beneficiaries are urban poor (individuals or groups) living below the poverty line (BPL) in urban areas. For Self-Employment Programme (SEP), individuals must be 18 years or above. Self Help Groups (SHGs) applying for group enterprises must consist of at least 5 members, with 70% of the members being women.
benefits_text: The scheme offers various benefits including skill training for employment and self-employment. Under the Self-Employment Programme (SEP), individuals can avail an interest subsidy on bank loans up to ₹2 lakh, while groups can avail subsidy on loans up to ₹10 lakh for setting up micro-enterprises. It also supports the formation of Self Help Groups (SHGs), provides support to urban street vendors, and facilitates shelters for the urban homeless.
ministry: Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs
application_steps: Form a Self Help Group (SHG) or identify as an individual urban poor.
Approach the Urban Local Body (ULB) or City Livelihoods Centre (CLC) for information and application forms.
Undergo skill training through empanelled training partners (if opting for skill development component).
Prepare a micro-enterprise business plan (for SEP) and apply for a bank loan with interest subsidy through ULB/CLC.

Select a lending institution (e.g., bank, NBFC, MFI) and submit the application with required documents for verification.

title: National Apprenticeship Promotion Scheme (NAPS)
description: NAPS is launched by the Government of India to promote apprenticeship training. It provides financial incentives to employers for engaging apprentices and offers partial support for basic training. The scheme helps youth gain practical skills and industry exposure through on-the-job training.
eligibility_text: Indian citizens aged 14 years or above. Educational qualifications generally range from a minimum of 5th standard pass up to ITI pass, diploma holders, or graduates. There is no upper age limit. The scheme is open to freshers and those with some prior experience.
benefits_text: Apprentices receive a stipend from the employer as per Apprenticeship Rules. ministry: Ministry of Skill Development and Entrepreneurship

Step 2: Search for available apprenticeship opportunities posted by establishments.
Step 3: Apply to suitable establishments and undergo the selection process for apprenticeship training.

title: Atal Pension Yojana (APY)
description: A pension scheme primarily aimed at workers in the unorganized sector. It provides a guaranteed minimum pension ranging from ₹1,000 to ₹5,000 per month after 60 years of age.
eligibility_text: Any citizen of India between the age of 18 to 40 years can join the scheme. The individual must have a savings bank account or a post office savings bank account. Income limits are not applicable, but it targets those without formal pension plans.
benefits_text: Guaranteed minimum pension of ₹1,000, ₹2,000, ₹3,000, ₹4,000, or ₹5,000 per month after attaining 60 years of age, depending on the contributions made. The same pension is paid to the spouse after the subscriber's death, and a lump sum amount is returned to the nominee.
ministry: Ministry of Finance
application_steps: Step 1: Approach any bank branch or post office that offers APY.
Step 2: Fill the APY registration form, providing Aadhaar and bank account details.
Step 3: Choose a desired fixed monthly pension amount (₹1,000 to ₹5,000) and the frequency of contribution (monthly/quarterly/half-yearly).
Step 4: Ensure regular contributions are made until the age of 60 through auto-debit from your bank account.

title: National Family Benefit Scheme (NFBS)
description: This scheme provides a lump sum financial assistance to a household below the poverty line (BPL) in the event of the death of the primary breadwinner. It is part of the National Social Assistance Programme (NSAP) aimed at providing social security to vulnerable sections.
eligibility_text: The deceased primary breadwinner should have been between 18 and 59 years of age at the time of death. The bereaved family must be identified as living Below Poverty Line (BPL) as per the criteria prescribed by the Government of India. The death can be natural or accidental.
benefits_text: A lump sum amount of ₹20,000 is provided to the bereaved family in the event of the death of the primary breadwinner.
ministry: Ministry of Rural Development
application_steps: Step 1: Obtain the death certificate of the primary breadwinner from the competent authority.
Step 2: Collect the BPL certificate and other required documents such as Aadhaar and bank passbook of the applicant.
Step 3: Apply to the concerned District Social Welfare Officer, Block Development Officer, or designated local authority.
Step 4: The application will be verified, and if approved, the financial assistance will be disbursed to the family's bank account.

title: Udyam Registration (MSME Registration)
description: Udyam Registration is a simplified, online, and free process for registering Micro, Small, and Medium Enterprises. It provides a unique Udyam Registration Number and certificate, which is mandatory for availing benefits under various MSME schemes and policies.
eligibility_text: Any enterprise that qualifies as a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise as per the revised definition based on investment in Plant & Machinery/Equipment and Turnover: Micro Enterprise (Investment up to Rs. 1 Crore and Turnover up to Rs. 5 Crore), Small Enterprise (Investment up to Rs. 10 Crore and Turnover up to Rs. 50 Crore), Medium Enterprise (Investment up to Rs. 50 Crore and Turnover up to Rs. 250 Crore).
benefits_text: Enables enterprises to access various government schemes, priority sector lending benefits, easier access to credit, protection against delayed payments, subsidies, and preferences in public procurement. It is a registration process to identify MSMEs and facilitate access to other benefits, not a direct financial benefit scheme itself.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
application_steps: Step 1: Go to the Udyam Registration portal.
Step 2: Enter Aadhaar number and Name of the Proprietor/Partner/Director.
Step 3: Fill in details such as PAN, GSTIN (if applicable), enterprise name, business activity, investment in plant & machinery/equipment, and turnover.
Step 4: Submit the form to receive the Udyam Registration Number and Certificate.

title: Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme (TUFS) for Textiles
title_hi: वस्त्रों के लिए प्रौद्योगिकी उन्नयन निधि योजना (TUFS)
description: The Technology Upgradation Fund Scheme (TUFS) provides credit-linked subsidies for modernization and technology upgradation of the Indian textile and jute industry. It aims to make the industry more competitive globally by facilitating investment in state-of-the-art machinery and technology.
eligibility_text: All textile and jute units, including spinning, weaving, processing, garmenting, technical textiles, and other segments of the textile value chain, are eligible if they have a definite plan for technology upgradation and modernization. The investment must be in eligible machinery as specified under the scheme guidelines.
benefits_text: Capital subsidy on eligible machinery/equipment. The subsidy rates vary across sub-sectors. Under the Amended TUFS (ATUFS), for example, a capital subsidy of 15% is provided for garmenting and technical textiles (with a cap of Rs. 30 Crore per project) and 6% for weaving, processing, and other segments (with a cap of Rs. 20 Crore per project).
ministry: Ministry of Textiles
application_steps: Step 1: Obtain Udyam Registration for the textile unit.
Step 2: Approach an eligible bank or financial institution for a term loan for the purchase of eligible machinery.
Step 3: Apply for the subsidy under TUFS through the bank, along with the loan application.
Step 4: The bank sanctions the loan and processes the subsidy claim with the Ministry of Textiles/Nodal Agencies.

title: National SC-ST Hub Scheme
description: The National SC-ST Hub Scheme aims to promote entrepreneurship among Scheduled Caste and Scheduled Tribe populations. It facilitates their participation in public procurement, provides hand-holding support, offers skill development, and helps them leverage various government schemes to foster economic empowerment.
eligibility_text: Scheduled Caste (SC) and Scheduled Tribe (ST) entrepreneurs who own a Micro, Small, or Medium Enterprise (MSME) are eligible. The enterprise must be registered with Udyam Registration and have at least 51% ownership by SC/ST entrepreneurs.
benefits_text: Provides a comprehensive support ecosystem for SC/ST entrepreneurs, including capacity building, tender training, marketing assistance, credit facilitation, and participation in trade fairs/exhibitions. The scheme also aims to achieve the Public Procurement Policy's target of 4% procurement from SC/ST Micro & Small Enterprises (MSEs). It focuses on support services and facilitation rather than direct financial grants to individuals.
ministry: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
application_steps: Step 1: Register on the National SC-ST Hub portal.
Step 2: Upload necessary documents, including Udyam Registration certificate and valid Caste Certificate.
Step 3: Participate in capacity building programs, vendor development programs, and access other support services provided by the Hub.
Step 4: Avail benefits like marketing support, credit facilitation, and public procurement opportunities.
